description: Configuration reference assembled from existing frozen settings; not a replacement for the historical training contract.

method.normalization: sum weighted token CE / sum valid token weights per slot; mean over effective slots
method.symbolic_policy: x=5 and X/2=0.5X have no first numeric operand: all valid tokens retain weight 1
method.span_policy: first signed decimal numeric literal per <<equation>>, including each equation in merged tail; overlapping BPE tokens
